notes.title: Roadmap: Achievement System, Bug Fix, Multi-Languages Support
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Thanks for playing Seed Hunter!
We already receive a lot of suggestions about how to make our game better. And we know we must going on to make this game better!

So in our roadmap, We will have following updates bring right to you:
- Achievement System, We already put our mind into it. In the next update, you can get it!
- Bug fix(We will fix bugs we already know)
- Multi-Languages Support. We are working on our English and Japanese version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/77eee589c241556aca6b065a65c1c0451def52f4.gif[/img]

If you meet any bugs or have any trouble, please share with us!
We will make our best to bring you the best game we can ever make.

Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: Seed Hunter V.1.0 is here, We out of Early Access!
notes.content:
Hunters,

After developing over 3 years, Seed Hunter V1.0 is finally here.
In this update, you will get the final chapter of the your Seed Hunting journey, fight with the owner of the tomb. Reveal long suppressed secrets about the tomb and the Wake Town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/4b58ffedf2072839f8cb5c0652d76171ddc1a0bc.gif[/img]

================

Seed Hunter
V.1.0

================

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/cb4f17bf47d7fd51a107ad07bcbf821966e02715.gif[/img]

In upcoming V.1.0, We will show you our new design for the Seed Hunter. The final map and even some convenient feature make your journey much easier.

Update features:
1. Final Map
2. Boss: Facing the owner of the tomb
3. Boss: Valemist
4. New Enemy: Guardian Serpent, Guardian Master, Guardian Servant, Guardian General, Guardian Archer, Guardian Geomancer
5. New Feature: Temporary Camp, a place for rest before the battle of Final boss
6. Steam Achievement Is Here!

Hunter, Can you make it?
Find the seed and even save this world? The Future is in your hand now!


Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: New Boss in V.0.2.5, Fallen Hunter Archer
notes.content:
Legend has it that we used to have a powerful hunter in the world, His name is Archer. He was a good guy helping citizens, accomplishing mission all day long. But as a hunter, power is most thing he ever want and he keep tracing on it.

But one day, he went to this town, which has a legendary statue power up its owner. For getting more power, this poor hunter stick to it…

He never come back,  become the powerful fallen hunter by losing his mind.
If you meet Archer, Stay away with him. He could end up your journey…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/7a945da4bd9c64c90436cc09516ec5207e9ea4a5.gif[/img]

You should soon receive an update to version v0.2.5 of the Seed Hunter, which includes the following changes:

================

Seed Hunter

Release Notes

v. 0.2.5

================

1. New Boss: Fallen Hunter, Archer
2. New Monster: A running treasure box, Don't miss it!
3. New Function: Random First Weapon 
4. BUG Fix: Black Screen bug
5. UX: Random Room now been improved

May our hunting begin again,
Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: Let's Explore The Latest Seed Hunter World
notes.content:
Hunters,

We are so exciting to bring you the First Ever Major Update in Seed Hunter. For us, we are working on this version for months, So our team just so exciting to share all details we bring to you in this version.

[h2]1. Hundreds of Ability Card is waiting![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/0d9b578700650afcee76ce8d7fa7b90ddd3e9952.gif[/img]

In our new version, we provide you with the new system making the Seed Hunting journey more joyful. The ability card system including 100 cards will make your journey cheerful and unpredictable each time!


[h2]2. Make Strongest Weapon by your hand[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/81cb273e2128ec506c0accd396124b3fff7e05b1.gif[/img]

We also bring you the latest weapon system. You can choose from 8 different skill by yourself making the strongest weapon we never seen before!

[h2]3. New Map System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/3a25150aa6565dc38c4973a94e983cd322cdf1b5.gif[/img]

Same old enemies, Same old place,
It must be lonely finding the secret energy in this world.

So in the coming version, We introduce you our latest map system.
New features with breaking events will give you so much surprise!


[h2]4. Three Visitors coming to Seed Hunter World[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/38edf23ad556dde183049e0f1d08a63d0d667c49.png[/img]

Miss Ya, the weapon maker and also the most powerful crafter in Seed Hunter world is waiting for you!
In Ya's room, you can finally have a chance taking a little break, updating your weapon and unlocking new skill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/5afa1d5449d6447d6bd982eb89be98ebece470dc.png[/img]

You must be a lucky guy if you meet the messenger!
Low HP? He will give you a helping hand. Too weak? You won't be by his power!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/0ea0b684b70517b8c9378684be3186303e3fe23d.png[/img]

Be careful if you meet grim Reaper!
For sure, you will be a stronger hunter, but you will take the risk of your life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/8f3148753db3cd9ecf2afd64735180f9b5f5f760.png[/img]

Ha! You must see our old friend, the old hunter!
It must means you are at the end of the dungeon, good luck! For some reason, he can't join your fight, but he can give you some free advice. 

[h2]5. Here comes the New Boss, Blessed Bloody Mary[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/377d9a3f432afb89fb9ab7e79a71aa9f0a59373a.gif[/img]

The new boss, Blessed Bloody Mary is coming to us. As the slave sacrificing to the source, this poor woman miraculously merge with the source but lose her soul forever. She build this dungeon and all monster by herself.

These violent delights have violent ends. 
Kill the Blessed Bloody Mary, Hunters, it is the only way to free her soul.

[h2]6. The New Survive Room[/h2]

It's a dangerous road for finding source, someone gets the fortune, Someone just never comes back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/d656de29b909158c83372481fc04c52ebf4356f6.gif[/img]

We add a new survival room in Seed Hunter which shows up randomly. If you enter this room, the only way to get out is killing all enemies! Survive, you will get lots of experience, dead, you will start from the beginning again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/0885f441da17e25c29526e50770a6c64fa145818.gif[/img]

Any thoughts? Tell us on the comment area! Our journey is just to begin!
Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: Skin, Weapon and Boos, New Seed Hunter, Check it out!
notes.content:
Hi hunters,

In this new version of our game. We provide you with new skin, new weapons and new Boss to our game! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/fdb4bc989174f25a20483356e990f3651d2ae3d4.jpg[/img]

1. New model | Updating the modeling of the main character to fit our game design.
2. New Boss | We hear your voice asking for a female character! This time, we adding a new female boss in our game.
3. New Weapon | Adding 3 Axe to our game and we also change system of Axes. Hoping you can like it!
4. Map Update | We adding some hidden maps in this version
5. Others | We also fixing some bugs and improving our gaming experience

So, That is, The new version of the Seed Hunter! Wishing you can like it! 
If you have any kind of question, Please contact com2p@outlook.com

Seed Hunter Team
